purpose: Single intake point for new public-information research hypotheses. FIFO only; no performance/selection authority.
instructions: Append a candidate object to candidates in queue order.
Each candidate needs id, name, hypothesis, construction, sources, next_gate, cheap_falsifiers, and gates.
Construction must encode a fixed or frozen deterministic/public-observation/PIT boundary.
Sources are provenance leads, not project evidence. Each candidate remains quarantined.
Never add returns, drawdowns, winner labels, selection/ranking, tuned parameters, or promotion fields.
The current three-candidate focus is not widened automatically; passing intake does not dispatch a workflow.
